lines.en: Hey, pal!
Ah!
Eddie, what are you still doing here?
Ah, just some basic dehydrating of a few fruits and vegetables.
Man alive, this thing's fantastic!
Look, Eddie, aren't you forgetting anything?
Oh, yeah, that's right. Look, I got us a new goldfish.
He's a lot feistier than the last one.
Yeah, maybe 'cause the last one was made by Pepperidge Farm.
Look, Eddie, isn't there something else you're supposed to be doing right now?
Well, not unless it's got something to do with dehydrating, my man,
'cause right now I'm a dehydrating maniac!
Look, you have to help me out here. I thought we had a deal.
I thought by the time I got...
You know what that is?
Your last roommate's kidney?
That's a tomato.
This one definitely goes in the display.
Ha, ha, ha, ha.
You're saying the display.
Ha, ha, ha, ha.
